stations.title: Order link
stations.text: The order number sits in the address.

captions: Then Ottilie forwards an email: Cosmo changed a link and saw a stranger's order.
The portal knows who is signed in, but never asks whose order it hands over.
You catch the peek, check the owner and write the test, in three tasks.
Now an order opens only for its own customer, and others get not found.
Same links, same table. The session decides what each customer sees.
